claims.Finding: Sora/Roxas +0xE8 thunk reads the fifth argument as BYTE at entry RSP+0x28, forwards Actor/32-bit delta/bar/effects to 3A85F0 and tail-jumps without touching HP itself.
claims.Limitations: Signedness is established by the downstream TEST/JNS, not the unsigned decompiler prototype. Only the confirmed common player descriptor is in scope.

claims.Finding: Rescue Mickey +0xE8 thunk has the same five-argument ABI and tail-jumps to 3A85F0.
claims.Limitations: Other Mickey models or derived descriptors are not admitted by this wrapper identity alone.

claims.Finding: For a nonnull status, mode byte431==1 and signed delta<0, adds damage-dependent Drive gain before tail-calling 3D5E50; calculation is (-delta/maxHP)*status552. There is no bar==0 test for this gain.
claims.Limitations: INT_MIN negation is 32-bit native NEG and can overflow. A pre-original guard should compute diagnostic magnitude in 64 bits and block only its scoped bar0 path.

claims.Finding: Uses bar as a signed 32-bit index into 12-byte status rows; rejects absent status/zero max or already defeated Actor, applies clamped HP, updates damage/heal HUD, invokes descriptor+176 when result==0 and bar==0, and returns resulting HP in EAX.
claims.Limitations: Direct callers bypass the two player-vtable slots. Positive healing has additional ally/revival/effect branches; they must be forwarded unchanged.

claims.Finding: Legacy base descriptor damage body performs the same damage-dependent gain and HP chain, but data points to base descriptor74A518/vtable5C4A80 rather than actual Sora/Roxas or rescue Mickey descriptors.
claims.Limitations: Hooking only5C4B68 does not cover player-derived virtual dispatch.

claims.Finding: For negative signed delta and a status not in MP recharge, computes truncated proportional MP gain using status556 and calls3D3CF0 if positive; masks effects when Actor396 bit0x4000 is set, then tail-calls3D2EB0.
claims.Limitations: Damage guard skips these gains when it returns before the original wrapper; forwarding delta0 is not equivalent because downstream HUD/death logic still runs.

claims.Finding: Mode1 converts gain through area scalar and, during MP recharge, battle-param120 and status528; writes normal Drive through3C0AD0. Modes2/3 use form/summon timer helper3C0B50 instead.
claims.Limitations: 3A85F0 itself invokes this only for mode1, so the damage-path claim does not imply extra form-timer gain for mode2.

claims.Finding: Returns Actor.status+464; caller offset88 therefore denotes status552 and offset64 denotes status528.
claims.Limitations: A nonnull/valid status must be established by callers.

claims.Finding: Adds signed delta to current row value, clamps between row floor+8 and max+4, writes current+0 and returns it in EAX; row stride12.
claims.Limitations: Arithmetic is native signed 32-bit with no overflow defense; no standalone bar boundscheck.

claims.Finding: Damage/nonpositive HUD branch uses global2A24E90, matching Actor and bar, then sends resulting HP to1832A0 when its widget exists.
claims.Limitations: It dereferences the HUD global before checking widget; blocking pre-original avoids this entire path, while forwarding assumes ordinary native validity.

claims.Finding: Recovery clears defeated bit, changes action/controller state and dispatches positive maxHP at bar0/effects0 through descriptor+E8.
claims.Limitations: This is a healing/recovery path and must not be intercepted as negative damage.

claims.Finding: Status-level HP adjustment dispatches Actor descriptor+E8 when status616 resolves an Actor; without a backlink it directly clamps/writes the status row and bypasses vtable hooks.
claims.Limitations: This establishes a bypass, not permission to hook or change the status-only path.

claims.Finding: Computes positive maxHP*param88 and dispatches at bar0/effects0 through the Actor descriptor.
claims.Limitations: For modified parameters the float conversion can become atypical; no blanket claim of safe data is made.

claims.Finding: Generic Actor HP-adjust shim decodes Actor descriptor, passes descriptor RCX/Actor RDX/delta R8D/bar R9D/fifth stack BYTE, and returns the vcall result unchanged.
claims.Limitations: Callers can pass signed deltas despite the unsigned inferred prototype.

claims.Finding: Reward/drop path can issue a positive byte HP increment via descriptor+E8 and independently add MP, Drive and other rewards.
claims.Limitations: A negative-HP-only guard does not suppress these positive awards.

claims.Finding: Hit processing invokes descriptor callbacks and an optional BDX event before a possible positive HP award through+E8, then dispatches target descriptor+192.
claims.Limitations: A guard at HP+E8 cannot undo already-run hit/BDX logic or later independent callbacks.

claims.Finding: BDX wrapper decodes handle→Actor, forwards 32-bit delta/bar and booleanized effects through descriptor+E8, then stores returned EAX with the VM integer tag.
claims.Limitations: Scripts reaching this wrapper can be affected during an admitted gameplay phase; direct HP assignments or other entry points are not covered.

claims.Finding: Rescue constructor installs descriptor7523B8 and flags, dispatches positive maxHP through its+E8 slot, restores MP, resets mode1 and updates rescue counters.
claims.Limitations: The constructor's positive restoration must remain forwarded; this report does not validate full resource construction.

claims.Finding: Alternate rescue construction installs the same Mickey descriptor, dispatches positive maxHP through+E8 and performs rescue bookkeeping before linking actors.
claims.Limitations: The allocation failure branch is native behavior; this report does not alter or probe it.

claims.Finding: Mickey-to-player recovery changes actor/controller state and dispatches a positive fraction of target maxHP through the target descriptor+E8.
claims.Limitations: The recovery target may differ from the outgoing Mickey Actor; a guard must bind exact current Actor/lifetime.

claims.Finding: Tests status float448>0 as the MP-recharge predicate used before damage-dependent MP gain.
claims.Limitations: No finite-value or status-range validation is contained in this leaf.

claims.Finding: Adds MP for a nondefeated actor with status; positive effects may invoke native recovery effect, while a negative resulting MP total enters recharge.

claims.Finding: Updates normal Drive fraction432 and bars433 using max434 and 100-unit carries; this is the eventual mode1 damage-gain write.

claims.Finding: Marks hit record24 bit2 before HP dispatch, applies native lethal-floor/one-damage conditions, negates damage for ordinary hit types, and returns the HP-shim result.
claims.Limitations: A pre-original HP guard preserves upstream processed-hit state; it cannot promise no hit reactions, no stagger or no script effects.

claims.Limitations: Drive initialization is a positive restoration path that must pass through unchanged.

claims.Finding: Drive transition task adds positive6 HP and MP to its retained transition status while that context exists, otherwise ends its task.
claims.Limitations: Guard blocks only negative HP and must not suppress this transition regeneration.

claims.Finding: Character status acquisition/rebuild can initialize a newly allocated status and add positive maxHP through the status shim.
claims.Limitations: During status construction actor backlink may be absent; that branch bypasses player-vtable callbacks.

claims.Finding: Sora/Roxas zeroHP callback branches among mission/event conditions, form/revert handling, summon cleanup and different game-over/rescue helpers.
claims.Limitations: Blocking damage before3D2EB0 also prevents this zeroHP dispatch; this narrow claim does not equate all branches with ordinary death.

claims.Finding: Mickey zeroHP callback forwards Actor to3A81C0.
claims.Limitations: It differs from Sora's mission/form/game-over branching and must not be replaced by the Sora callback.

claims.Finding: ZeroHP common preparation updates the Actor controller, clears Actor3544 and forwards to3D5DC0.
claims.Limitations: Full controller/game-over semantics of callees are outside this report.

claims.Finding: Common zeroHP path dispatches descriptor+160 with argument2 and then calls3D2E80.
claims.Limitations: The descriptor-specific state transition remains native; it is skipped if the guarded negative HP callback never calls original.

contract.abi: intptr_t __fastcall(uintptr_t descriptor, uintptr_t actor, int32_t signedDelta, uint32_t bar, uint8_t effects). Win64 fifth byte at callee-entry RSP+0x28; forward original exactly once unless deliberately blocked; returned HP is zero-extended EAX, not a success boolean.
contract.block: Only negative signedDelta, bar==0, living verified current player, exact role/descriptor/Actor generation, owned current slot, original pinned code, game-thread, fresh host and scoped stable scene/phase. Return unchanged current HP without invoking original.
contract.ownership: Use constructor-observed generation; Actor address/status pointer alone is insufficient. Bind any deferred release to its activation owner so stale host cleanup cannot remove a later manual guard.
sideEffectsSkipped: zeroHP descriptor callback and its form/game-over/rescue branches
sideEffectsPreserved: upstream processed-hit marking and native floor/one-hit adjustments
other hit reactions and BDX callbacks before/after the HP dispatcher
all positive/zero deltas, nonzero bars and rejected guard contexts forwarded to native
direct status writes and direct calls bypassing these slots remain native
contract.hookSafety: Pin the resident module; validate slot allocation/protection/alignment and descriptor table ownership; CAS only expected own pointers. Preserve immutable original target independently per wrapper and keep it outside validation exception handling. Never swallow native exceptions.
contract.pins: CombatGuardPins.inl contains only9 complete bodies for the entry ABI, HP dispatch/write/return and core producer contract. It does not pin every downstream game resource/HUD/death function.
limits: No live injection/game testing was performed.

General input-controllable state is not a prerequisite for blocking: knockback may already block input while HP protection should remain active. Scene/event/transition and actor-lifetime gates remain necessary.
Read-only evidence confirms static dispatch and side effects, not all modded asset values or concurrent foreign code changes.
Do not advertise complete invulnerability. Scripted direct writes and bypassing native calls are outside these two slot hooks.
